chapters.label: Wembley, 2024
chapters.text: Wembley, 2024, the Champions League final. Still nil–nil. Toni Kroos whips in a corner... Dani Carvajal flicks it in! Real Madrid lead!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Carvajal is shorter than the striker beside him. He darts to the near post, gets in front, and jumps first.

chapters.label: The glance
chapters.text: From beside the goal, see him glance it. It flies across the keeper, into the far corner! Real Madrid win their fifteenth European Cup!

chapters.label: Attack the near post
chapters.text: Attack the near post! Get there first, time your jump, and glance it on. Small players can win headers too!
